reason: The company's 2023 Universal Registration Document (20-F equivalent) does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The document provides extensive operational metrics including production volumes, installed capacities, sales figures, and market positions across oil & gas, LNG, power generation, refining, petrochemicals, and marketing segments. However, it does not quantify the total market size or TAM for any of these business segments. The company focuses on its operational performance, financial results, and transition strategy targets (e.g., net zero by 2050, renewable capacity goals) rather than disclosing market sizing data.
